name: Sarah Chen
subject: How do I invite my team to FlowSync?
message: We just signed up for the Pro plan and I need to get my 8-person engineering team onboarded today. How do I invite them and what permissions should I give developers vs. managers?
expected_response: Step-by-step invitation process, explanation of roles (Admin, Member, Guest), link to team management docs

name: Marcus Johnson
subject: GitHub integration not syncing pull requests
message: Our GitHub integration was working fine until yesterday, but now PRs aren't showing up in FlowSync tasks. We're using the #TASK-123 format in PR descriptions but nothing is linking. This is blocking our sprint workflow.
expected_response: Troubleshooting steps for GitHub OAuth token refresh, reconnection instructions, verify FlowSync app permissions in GitHub

name: Emily Rodriguez
subject: Need to upgrade to Enterprise plan for 500 users
message: We're currently on Business plan with 120 users but our company is rolling out FlowSync company-wide to 500+ employees. We need Enterprise pricing, SSO with Okta, and a custom contract with Net-60 payment terms. What's the process?
expected_response: Escalate to Sales team with enterprise_inquiry category

name: David Park
subject: How to set up Slack notifications for project updates?
message: I connected FlowSync to Slack but I'm getting notifications for everything. I only want notifications for tasks in our 'Product Development' project to go to #product-dev channel. How do I configure this?
expected_response: Instructions for per-project Slack channel configuration in Project Settings > Notifications

name: Jennifer Lee
subject: Guest user can see all projects - security issue!
message: We invited a client as a Guest user and gave them access to only one project, but they're saying they can see our internal projects too. This is a major security concern - we have confidential client information in those projects.
expected_response: Verify guest permissions setup, check if workspace is set to 'Team-wide' vs 'Private' projects, explain project visibility settings

name: Robert Martinez
subject: Automation deleted 200 tasks by mistake
message: I set up an automation to move completed tasks to an archive project, but it accidentally deleted over 200 tasks instead. We need these restored immediately - they contain critical sprint planning data for our Q1 roadmap. Can you recover them from backup?
expected_response: Escalate to Engineering immediately with data_loss category, freeze account, investigate backup restore

name: Amanda Foster
subject: How to create recurring tasks for weekly standup?
message: Our team has a standup meeting every Monday at 9am. I want to create a recurring task that automatically creates a new standup task each week. Is this possible in FlowSync?
expected_response: Instructions for creating recurring tasks with weekly frequency and specific day/time

name: Kevin Nguyen
subject: API rate limit - getting 429 errors
message: Our CI/CD pipeline integrates with FlowSync API to create tasks from test failures. We're hitting rate limits (429 errors) during our nightly build that creates about 50 tasks. We're on Pro plan. How can we increase our rate limit or batch these requests?
expected_response: Escalate to technical_complex, explain rate limits by plan, suggest Business plan upgrade or API optimization strategies

name: Lisa Thompson
subject: SSO login not working - entire team locked out
message: We set up SSO with Azure AD yesterday and now nobody on our 200-person team can log in. Getting 'SAML authentication failed' error. This is blocking all work company-wide. URGENT - need immediate help.
expected_response: Escalate to security_concern immediately, treat as critical, contact Enterprise support team

name: Michael Chen
subject: Charged twice for same month
message: We were charged $228 on March 1st and another $228 on March 15th for the same Pro plan subscription. This looks like a duplicate charge. I need one of these refunded immediately as we're a small startup and this affects our cash flow.
expected_response: Escalate to billing_dispute, Billing team will investigate duplicate charge and process refund if confirmed

name: Rachel Green
subject: How to export project data to Excel?
message: I need to export all tasks from our Q1 Planning project to share with our CFO who doesn't use FlowSync. Can I export to Excel with all custom fields included?
expected_response: Instructions for CSV/Excel export, explain that Excel export with formatting requires Business plan, CSV available on all plans

name: James Wilson
subject: Need SOC 2 report for security audit
message: Our security team is conducting a vendor audit and requires your SOC 2 Type II report. We're on the Business plan with 85 users. How do I request this?
expected_response: Escalate to compliance_inquiry, direct to compliance@flowsync.io, mention NDA requirement

name: Olivia Martinez
subject: Jira sync creating duplicate tasks
message: We enabled two-way Jira sync last week and now every Jira issue is creating duplicate tasks in FlowSync. When we update in Jira, it creates another duplicate instead of updating the existing one. How do we fix this?
expected_response: Troubleshooting steps for Jira field mapping, verify unique ID mapping, reconnect integration, delete duplicates

name: Daniel Kim
subject: How to set up custom approval workflow?
message: We need a multi-stage approval process for our client deliverables: Designer creates → PM reviews → Client approves → Developer implements. Can FlowSync handle this workflow? We're on Pro plan.
expected_response: Explain custom approval workflows require Business plan, describe automation alternative for Pro plan, suggest upgrade

name: Sophia Anderson
subject: GDPR data deletion request
message: We have a customer who exercised their right to erasure under GDPR. We need to delete all their data from FlowSync including tasks, comments, and time tracking entries where they're mentioned. What's the process?
expected_response: Escalate to gdpr_request, direct to compliance procedure, mention 30-day processing time

name: Christopher Taylor
subject: Mobile app not syncing offline changes
message: I created 10 tasks on the mobile app while on a flight (offline mode). When I landed and reconnected to WiFi, only 3 of them synced to FlowSync. The other 7 are missing. Using iOS app version 2.4.1.
expected_response: Escalate to technical_complex, collect device info, investigate offline sync issue, check if tasks stored locally

name: Ashley Brown
subject: Can we integrate with HubSpot?
message: Our sales team uses HubSpot and we want to automatically create FlowSync tasks when a deal moves to 'Closed Won'. I don't see HubSpot in the integrations list. Is this possible?
expected_response: Explain no native HubSpot integration, suggest Zapier as alternative, link to Zapier integration docs

name: Ryan Miller
subject: Account compromised - unauthorized access from Russia
message: I just received an email alert about a login to our FlowSync account from an IP address in Russia. We're a US-based company and none of our team is traveling. I'm concerned our account was hacked. Please lock the account immediately and investigate.
expected_response: Escalate to security_concern immediately, freeze account, escalate to Security team, reset passwords, audit access logs

name: Victoria Wang
subject: How to track billable hours per client?
message: We're a consulting firm working with multiple clients. We need to track billable hours separately for each client and generate invoices at the end of the month. Can FlowSync handle this? We're on Pro plan.
expected_response: Explain time tracking with billable toggle, per-project billing rates, time tracking reports filtered by project, CSV export for invoicing

name: Andrew Davis
subject: Webhook not firing for task.completed event
message: We set up a webhook to trigger our deployment pipeline when tasks tagged 'release' are completed. The webhook endpoint is verified (we tested with curl and it works), but FlowSync isn't sending the webhook payload. Checked logs and see no POST requests from FlowSync in the last 24 hours despite completing 5 release tasks.
expected_response: Escalate to technical_complex, verify webhook configuration, check event filters, test webhook delivery, investigate if webhook is paused/disabled

name: Nicole Garcia
subject: THIS IS UNACCEPTABLE - SWITCHING TO MONDAY.COM
message: I've been trying to get help with our GitHub sync issue for THREE DAYS and nobody has resolved it. Our entire 50-person engineering team cannot work properly. We have tickets open with no response. This is completely unacceptable for what we're paying ($1,950/month). I'm evaluating Monday.com and Asana as replacements and will be canceling our annual contract unless someone fixes this TODAY. I want to speak to a manager immediately.
expected_response: Escalate to churn_risk + high_frustration, acknowledge frustration, escalate to Customer Success immediately, mention 1-hour response SLA

name: Thomas Anderson
subject: How to use API to bulk create tasks from CSV?
message: We're migrating from Trello and have 800+ tasks in a CSV file. Rather than manually importing, I want to write a script to bulk create these via the FlowSync API. Is there a bulk create endpoint or do I need to loop through individual POST requests? What are the rate limits?
expected_response: Explain API rate limits by plan, no bulk endpoint but batch recommended, link to API docs, mention CSV import feature as alternative

name: Maria Rodriguez
subject: Need data residency in EU for GDPR compliance
message: Our company is based in Germany and we need to ensure all FlowSync data is stored in EU data centers for GDPR compliance. Currently our data seems to be in US. We're on Business plan with 150 users. Can we migrate to EU data residency?
expected_response: Escalate to compliance_inquiry, explain data residency is Enterprise-only feature, offer Enterprise upgrade, contact support for migration

name: Brandon Scott
subject: Timeline view not showing dependencies correctly
message: I set up task dependencies using 'blocks' and 'blocked by' relationships but they're not appearing as connected lines in Timeline view. I can see the dependencies in the task details but the visual timeline doesn't show the relationships. Is this a bug or am I missing something?
expected_response: Verify dependencies are saved, check browser cache, explain Timeline view shows dependencies as connecting lines, Gantt view has more advanced dependency visualization (Business+)

name: Jessica Turner
subject: Can we white-label FlowSync for our clients?
message: We're a design agency and want to use FlowSync to manage client projects, but we'd like to white-label it with our branding so clients see our logo instead of FlowSync. Is this possible on any plan? We're currently on Pro with 12 users.
expected_response: Escalate to enterprise_inquiry, explain white-labeling is custom Enterprise feature, requires custom contract, direct to Sales team
